description: Navigate to the 'Connect the Dots' activity in GCompris (Mathematics > Numeracy). Solve the first available puzzle by clicking the numbered points in ascending order (1, 2, 3...) to reveal the hidden picture. Once the picture is revealed, save a screenshot of it to '~/Documents/solved_dots.png' and create a text file at '~/Documents/object_id.txt' containing a sentence identifying what the object is (e.g., 'It is a butterfly').
